Class CarouselManager

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.ui.CarouselManager
public class CarouselManager extends Object
Manages a horizontally scrollable carousel of robot toggle buttons in a JavaFX UI.

It handles the creation of visual clones to allow seamless looping, synchronizes toggle selection with scrolling, and allows navigation between available robots.
